meta.name: add-whatsapp
meta.description: Add WhatsApp channel via native Baileys adapter. Direct connection — no Chat SDK bridge. Uses QR code or pairing code for authentication.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过二维码或配对码直连 WhatsApp 频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中直接连接 WhatsApp 发送或接收消息。
copy.tagline_en: Connect WhatsApp channel via QR code or pairing code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to directly connect WhatsApp in your app to send or receive messages.

howto.what: 为 NanoClaw 新增 WhatsApp 渠道，使用 Baileys 直接连接 WhatsApp Web，通过扫码或配对码认证。安装后 NanoClaw 能通过 WhatsApp 收发消息，并根据号码类型（专用或个人）调整安全与收发行为。
howto.when: 当用户要求为 NanoClaw 添加 WhatsApp 渠道时触发，流程包括安全检查、二维码或配对码认证等。

say.text: 请为 NanoClaw 添加 WhatsApp 渠道
say.note: 开始安装和配置 WhatsApp 渠道。

say.text: 用我的个人号码连接 WhatsApp
say.note: 会进行共享号码风险提示并继续认证。

say.text: 用二维码方式链接 WhatsApp
say.note: 终端显示二维码，用手机扫码完成绑定。

howto.what_en: Adds a WhatsApp channel to NanoClaw via native Baileys adapter, direct WhatsApp Web connection, auth by QR or pairing code. NanoClaw can then message over WhatsApp, with behavior depending on dedicated or shared number mode.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to add a WhatsApp channel to NanoClaw. The process includes a number safety check, copying the adapter, installing dependencies, and linking the device via QR or pairing code.

say_en.text: Please add a WhatsApp channel to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Starts the channel installation and setup.

say_en.text: Connect WhatsApp using my personal number.
say_en.note: Shows the account-risk warning and proceeds with shared-number auth.
Displays a QR code in the terminal to scan with your phone.
